analyst_view.overall: Early view: AZ host leaders PSV four days before PSV face Atletico Madrid in the Champions League and five days before AZ host Sturm Graz in the Europa League. AZ outshot Ajax 19 to 5 at home and still lost 0-1, while PSV have dropped points to ADO and Twente this season.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals. I lean lower: games between top-five sides have been tighter this season (AZ 0-1 Ajax), and both coaches have a European game the following week to manage.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, evenly split. AZ's wing play and PSV's possession should both produce corners; I see no reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.1 cards. Big games can get tense, but neither side has bans or disciplinary trouble in the news, so I keep it.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.8 shots. I lean higher: AZ shot 19 times at home against Ajax and PSV rarely go a game without plenty of attempts.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10 shots on target. AZ's volume has not always turned into shots on goal, which balances the higher shot count; I keep it.
